name: Sweet Potato Cottage Pie
method: Peel the sweet potatoes, cut into chunks and boil for 15 minutes until soft. Drain, mash and stir in the yoghurt.
Brown the mince in the oil in a large pan, then add the chopped onion and grated carrot and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the tomatoes, crumbled stock cube, oregano and a splash of water and simmer for 10 minutes until thick.
Spoon the mince into a dish, top with the mash and grill or bake at 200C for 10 to 15 minutes until crisp at the edges. Serve with the peas.
